Author: Arka & XeldarAlz
Name: Puls8
Punchline: Your neon pass to the Puls8 club: travel, syncshells and venue mods in one tap.
Description:
The official companion for Puls8, a rooftop lounge and pool on Raiden (Lavender Beds, Ward 7, Plot 16).

- Tap to travel to the club with Lifestream
- Live open/closed status, weekly schedule in your local time, and event reminders
- Join the venue syncshell (Lightless) or turn on ZoneSync (PlayerSync) in one tap
- Guided, self-checking installer for the Puls8 Penumbra packs (Cityscape & Skybox, Venue Pack)
